name: mgt-quoting
description: For insurance agents: quote MGT small-business commercial insurance from ChatGPT. Check appetite, classify the business, and create and edit quotes.

interface.longDescription: MGT Quoting is for insurance agents who quote small-business commercial insurance with MGT Insurance. ChatGPT checks whether MGT writes a business, picks the right classification, and creates and edits quotes for MGT products such as Business Owner Policy, specialty general liability, specialty property, and farm. Results can be wrong, and binding happens in MGT's portal, not in ChatGPT. Available to accounts that can quote on the MGT platform.
defaultPrompt: Does MGT write a bakery in Austin, Texas?
Create a Business Owner Policy quote for a 3-person dental office.
Classify a mobile dog grooming business for MGT.
